description: Build the ratified attendee-schedule feature end to end, reproducing the binding prototype one-to-one. Binding artifacts: sequence/attendee-schedule-design.md (decisions + prototype-round rulings) and prototypes/attendee-schedule/index.html (binding visual contract). Scope: (1) single-session Add-to-calendar ICS on /s/:slug reusing src/jobs/calendar/ics.ts; (2) star control as SSR slots + vanilla script module on public agenda cards and session detail (MRQ-120 hooks merged in PR #86; add data-public-session-end); localStorage state; segmented header 'Conference agenda | My schedule (n)'; My Schedule itinerary view with at-a-glance time blocks, NOW line, hover cards, subtle overlap chips, origin-preserving back-nav; (3) D1-backed short codes: POST/GET/PUT /api/v1/public/schedules (code=read, hashed writeKey=write), share URL, open-on-your-phone QR sheet with #k fragment sync, import-as-copy; (4) set-level ICS download + live webcal feed at /api/v1/public/schedules/{code}.ics; (5) Brief-your-agent text block + For-agents doc; overlaps[] in schedule JSON. Register rows 37/38, section T-J (post-eval product feature). Mobile verified at 390px per doc rulings. No login anywhere.
title: Attendee personal schedule — star, My Schedule, share/sync, ICS/webcal, agent briefing
